body:
## Summary

Allow Chrome extension users to select Japanese → English or English → Japanese independently of the optional translation checkbox. Keep Japanese → English as the default, persist both preferences, apply changes to the next session, and preserve each session's input/output labels on provisional text and paired final rows.

English → Japanese uses its own production Node/Worker with `Kadonox/opus-tatoeba-en-ja-onnx` at immutable revision `225fd3c2970d899c05b4ddde2fdeda2ffdc8a69e`. The verified OPUS Tatoeba conversion replaces the Bible-domain checkpoint that failed ordinary English. Its seven assets total 252,634,769 bytes; an independent manifest pins all sizes and whole-file/chunk hashes. Both conversion and base model cards declare Apache 2.0; attribution and terms are documented. The Worker prepares uppercase ReazonSpeech input for the case-sensitive model while preserving the visible/copyable original.

## Outcome

Reuse existing provisional latest-wins scheduling, FIFO final pairing, cancellation and stale-output protection. Explicit preparation downloads only the selected model, with independent readiness/progress/errors and verified offline reuse. Model weights remain outside the extension bundle; capture permissions/CSP are unchanged. The independent English → Japanese production Node Playground page is linked from the index.

## Validation

[Review-fix evidence](docs/evidence/translation-direction-71-fixes.md) distinguishes deterministic tests and real inference on macOS / Chrome-for-Testing 153.0.8010.12:

- 163 unit tests passed; rerun successfully at the earlier implementation publication.
- 36 focused Chromium/WebKit browser tests passed after case preparation.
- 40 deterministic MV3 tests passed after checkpoint replacement; 13 focused direction/cache/scheduling tests passed after case preparation. Default real-model smokes are explicitly opt-in.
- The real production-page smoke passed 20 translations: five ordinary-English meanings, normal and ASR uppercase forms, each on two fresh Workers.
- The real English → Japanese MV3 smoke passed online and after offline recorder recreation. A clearly identified synthetic speech fixture runs through native tab capture and production ASR/translation; actual final pairs preserve meeting time, report request and project deadline. Each run additionally checks 10 ordinary-text translations through the production cache-only Pipeline. No runtime/model mocks or remote inference requests.
- Immutable model metadata/size/hash review, extension build and whitespace checks passed.
- An earlier documentation-only checkpoint added the reviewed corrections: the en-ja download is about 253 MB and conversion attribution is Kadonox. The translation asset test (1 passed) and `git diff --check` passed for that checkpoint; the earlier real-inference results above were not rerun for those documentation-only changes.
- Japanese → English model/Worker/runtime are unchanged; both-direction deterministic regressions pass. Its real-model smoke was not rerun during these fixes.

The checkpoint can still make mistakes on complex or malformed technical transcripts. The ordinary-speech semantic checks establish the tested behavior, not universal translation accuracy.

**Required post-merge Pages verification: pending.** After merge, record the successful Pages run URL, merged/deployed SHA, UTC verification time, canonical `https://takahirox.github.io/my-audio-to-text/nodes/opus-mt-en-ja/` loading/index link, and valid script/Worker/runtime/immutable model URLs. Local checks do not establish deployment of the merged SHA. The unpacked extension has no deployment-only gate.
